category: currency exchange rate API, keyless open access

free_tier.stated: Open access API with no key: GET https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD, rates updated once per day, rate limited per IP address.
free_tier.notes: The page names no request count and no per-minute number. Requesting once every 24 hours needs no further reading, and one request an hour per server never meets the limit. A rate limited IP address receives HTTP 429 for 20 minutes.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the per-IP rate limit bounds what a caller can pull

interface_detail: GET https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD returns JSON with all supported currencies against the base
chaining: A daily table of all currencies with no sign-up; cache it for 24 hours. Pair this with data-apis/exchangerate-api when a key is acceptable.

limits.value: a rate limit per IP address with no published number; a limited address receives HTTP 429 for 20 minutes

limits_note: Update rate: once per day. Bulk path: none; the page asks to cache the daily table.
binding_note: The only limit is the per-IP shaping with no published threshold; one request an hour never meets it.
reliability_note: A rate limited IP address receives HTTP 429 and is let through again after 20 minutes.
confidence_note: Limits and license are quoted from the open access docs page. One keyless GET answered HTTP 200 with a success body; the rate threshold was not measured.

evidence.proved: the open API needs no key
the open API updates once per day
one request an hour never meets the rate limit
evidence.quote: If you can't keep a cached response for that long, you could still request once every hour and never get rate limited.

evidence.proved: a limited IP address gets 429 for 20 minutes
evidence.quote: Rate limited IP's will receive HTTP code 429 responses. After 20 minutes the rate limit will finish and new requests will be allowed through.
You're welcome to cache the data we respond with and to use it for either personal or commercial currency conversion purposes. You are, however, not allowed to re-distribute it.

evidence.proved: a keyless GET of the open endpoint answered HTTP 200
the keyless answer body reports success

notes: Free requests: no count, no key. Rate limit: per IP address, no number published. re-distribution is not allowed. Bulk path: none.

extras.bulk_path: none; one daily table of all currencies per request
extras.free_requests: no count; per-IP rate limit, number not published
